DRAFT: the coordinator copies this to queue/jobs/ only after the science-reviewer freeze check of the fetcher, the committed rules file and a smoke PASS. Exit 75 (headroom: data-dumps size + the 0.25 GB output cap would pass 12.5 GB) means not now (30-minute wait, not counted); exit 2 refuses on a rules-hash mismatch, ANY missing or sha256-mismatched exclusion file, a missing or non-PASS smoke result (or one made under another rules hash), changed declared arguments, run ids h2_main/h3_power/h4_seal/h5_*/h6_weather/h7_*. Chunks stop at --budget-min 85 (below timeout_s 5400 so a chunk ends gracefully and is never killed mid-market; the doc says 90-minute chunks and timeout 6600, the coordinator's 5400 was applied); resumable by exclusion batch, frame day and market; one T_fetch8 is pinned in request_clock.json. Stage order: exclusion keys (about 850 requests including the closed=true retry), frame walk (about 1-2.5k requests), filters + key drop + sample + origins (origins.csv.gz written before any price request), then per market about 3 price requests, about 3-9 print requests and cached wallet lookups: about 30-45k requests in all, about 3-3.5 h wall at 4 rps in about 3 chunks. Terminal statuses: tail_fetch_complete; not_run_deadline (no chunk starts at or after T_seal; NOT_RUN_DEADLINE.json); disjointness_unverified (> 2% of exclusion ids without Gamma metadata; no sample, no prices). Commit message must record the section 2.8 headroom check (1.0 GB/day). Latest safe start on the host 2026-10-21T12:00Z. Host only: the Mac fallback was removed 2026-10-17 (Mac data dumps retired, no background jobs on the Mac; CREATIVE_BATCH_6.md section 2.8); if q0120 cannot complete on the host before T_seal it is recorded not_run_deadline and counted.
